messages.content: You are reviewing a cloud-planned autonomous coding program compiler. Return only the contracted JSON. Prefer a minimal mechanically enforceable change.

A planner emits a DAG of missions, each with objective, focusPaths, and one acceptanceKey. Current validation only requires union coverage of requiredFocusPaths and use of requiredAcceptanceKeys. This allowed source and regression test to be split into separately accepted missions: source passed weak old tests; a failing regression test could not integrate alone. Propose a requiredMissionBundles input that can require at least one mission to jointly cover specified source/test focus paths under a specified acceptanceKey. Define exact validation semantics, planner prompt projection, and tests. Consider directory-prefix focus coverage and multiple bundles.

completion.text: {"edgeCases":["No missions match the specified focus paths or acceptance key.","Duplicate focus paths in separate missions.","All missions fail to meet the required acceptance key."],"prompt":["Define `requiredMissionBundles` input structure including mission specifications.","Describe validation process to ensure at least one mission under a specified acceptanceKey covers all focusPaths."],"tests":["Test with valid missions fulfilling focus paths under the acceptance key.","Test with missions that do not fulfill the acceptance key.","Test the scenario where multiple bundles meet acceptance requirements but only one bundle is required."],"validation":["Mission must cover at least one focusPath from the specified set.","AcceptanceKey must be present in the missions selected from the bundles."]}
